Sofia, I saved the note to June as a draft in your mailbox (to joseilark@pemberline.com, subject "Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail): label confusion"). Nothing is sent. Please check the wording before you send it.

Here are the bullets for #coastal-team:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. The CRM code changed from CLR to PHL.
- The saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". One version of the Inbound arrivals export also still has the old Covey & Lark Retail header.
- "Covey" in older notes means the same account as Pellow Home Living.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so check the dropdowns when filing tickets.
